# Foundry source priority

1. Official Microsoft Learn service pages: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry/agents/overview and https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/deploy-hosted-agent.
2. Agent Framework host and runtime docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/agent-framework/hosting/.
3. Security and RBAC: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry/concepts/rbac-foundry?view=foundry-classic and https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/mcp-authentication.
4. Evaluation, quota and networking: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry/concepts/evaluation-evaluators/agent-evaluators, https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry/agents/concepts/limits-quotas-regions, https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/virtual-networks.
5. Microsoft Foundry coding-agent skill: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry/how-to/develop/use-microsoft-foundry-skill.

Never treat memory, search snippets, or an old tutorial as current proof when upstream pages can be checked. Require exact links for preview statements and confirm any deployment command against its language/runtime variant.
